The football section was once among Austria's most popular clubs, enjoying success in the decade between 1995 and 2005. The other sections are [[basketball]], [[Diving (sport)|diving]] and [[tennis]], which however all act as separate legal entities. The "GAK" football section folded during the 2012–13 [[Austrian Regionalliga|Regionalliga]] Mitte Season in Autumn 2012. It has since been revived and returned to the [[Austrian Football Second League|Austrian Second League]] in 2019,{{Cite web |title=2019/20 Ende! Der GAK trifft auf den SV Lafnitz. |url=https://grazerak.at/aktuelles/gak-trifft-auf-sv-lafnitz |access-date=29 September 2023 |website=Im letzten Spiel der Saison treffen wir auf den SV Lafnitz. ... |language=de}} and four years later won promotion to the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga|Austrian Bundesliga]] after a seventeen-year hiatus.{{Cite web |title=Zurück aus der Gruft – GAK 1902 is back! |url=https://grazerak.at/aktuelles/zurueck-aus-der-gruft |access-date=16 May 2024 |website=Im letzten Spiel der Saison treffen wir auf den SV Lafnitz. ... |language=de}}"}}
